protocol.purpose: Synthetic bounded numerical and scaling checks for the packed SurfacePlate processor.
protocol.cpuDisclaimer: Node VM timings and Chrome main-thread JavaScript proxy timings are not AudioWorklet realtime measurements.
masks: deterministic narrow Y-shaped trail corridor masks
protocol.simulation: One bounded grouped strike followed by a short tail; long natural decay is separately checked on the narrow mask.

energyEstimators.discreteDiagnostic: Plate: 0.5*rho*velocity^2 + 0.5*rho*bending*(Laplacian u)^2 + 0.5*tension*undirectedNeighborGradient^2; adjacent layers: 0.5*compiledLinkCoefficient*(uA-uB)^2; sphere: 0.5*modalMass*velocity^2 + 0.5*modalMass*(2-2*cos(omega))*q^2; foundation: 0.5*weight*springConstant*(plateDisplacement-sum(SH*q))^2.
energyEstimators.limitations: Leapfrog cross-strain terms, damping, sleep truncation and awake-set changes are not represented as conserved physical energy. Reported totals/ranges are bounded diagnostic estimators only.

physicalEnergyEstimator.disclaimer: Discrete diagnostic estimator; damping, leapfrog cross-strain terms, sleeping cutoffs and coupling proxies mean it is not a full continuum conservation proof.

resourceAccounting.byteDefinition: Sum of byteLength for compiler topology typed arrays and direct worklet typed arrays; excludes JS object/array overhead, audio engine buffers and browser process memory.
resourceAccounting.capRationale: 256 is a technical history safety ceiling. Frozen history is retained without eviction; compilation and storage at the ceiling do not assert that all 256 full masks stay awake or meet real-time deadlines.

cases.note: No all-awake 256-layer runtime claim; sleep/wake and device-specific workload remain separate.

subcellContact.interpretation: Five within-cell synthetic foot-contact offsets verify finite, bounded quadrature response. This is a contact-energy proxy, not a measured biological force or acoustic-energy conservation proof.
